newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech FinMin sees energy sell-off plan in 3weeks.
newsitem.headline: Czech FinMin sees energy sell-off plan in 3weeks.

text.p: The Czech Finance Ministry said on Thursday that a proposal for selling off the state's remaining stakes in the country's regional energy distributors will be presented to the government within three weeks.
"I have prepared...privatisation of the distribution companies. This is a question of three weeks at maximum (until it is proposed to the cabinet)," Finance Minister Ivan Kocarnik told a conference.
The Czech Republic's main privatisation agency, the National Property Fund (NPF), owns between 40 and 50 percent of each of the country's 16 regional gas and electricty distributors.
The government had originally set asside 20 percent stakes in the distribution companies for foreign investors but subsequently backed away from the idea.
